about.title: About Me
about.p1: As a Product-Led Full Stack Developer and UX/UI Designer with over 15 years of experience, my background uniquely blends Marketing, high-level Design, and Full-Stack Engineering.
about.p2: I specialize in Python (Flask) and React ecosystems, building secure, full-scale digital solutions like the Xplora Tour Management Platform. Prior to this, I founded and scaled ABISMO, expanding a diving school for 200+ clients across multiple markets by leveraging custom CRM implementations, SEO/SEM strategies, and product strategy.
about.p3: Through a product-focused approach, I integrate robust backend architectures (PostgreSQL, APIs, AWS) with visually compelling frontends, ensuring every application meets both core business objectives and user needs. My goal is to deliver technical excellence intertwined with measurable business value.
